module: Flowgraph node "Keep Prefab" (once_instant). Marks a prefab to be kept after the flowgraph stops; by default a prefab created during execution is deleted at the end. Inputs: id (number), keep (bool). Uses self.mgr.modules.prefab:setKeepPrefab.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

workOnce.desc: Calls setKeepPrefab(id, keep) and copies the flow input to the flow output.
